python3 -c "
import json, glob
files = sorted(glob.glob('/root/autodl-tmp/eval_results/eval_multiseed_*.json'))
for f in files:
    d = json.load(open(f))
    name = f.split('/')[-1]
    print(f'=== {name} ===')
    print(f'  seed={d[\"config\"][\"seed\"]}, model_type={d[\"config\"][\"model_type\"]}')
    print(f'  checkpoint={d[\"config\"][\"checkpoint\"].split(\"/\")[-2]}')
    cars = [r[\"CAR\"] for r in d[\"results\"]]
    tsrs = [r[\"TSR\"] for r in d[\"results\"]]
    avg_car = sum(cars)/len(cars)
    avg_tsr = sum(tsrs)/len(tsrs)
    print(f'  avg_CAR={avg_car:.4f}, avg_TSR={avg_tsr:.4f}')
    for r in d['results']:
        tn = r['task_name'].replace('pick_up_the_','').replace('_and_place_it_in_the_basket','')
        ee = r.get('avg_max_ee_displacement', 'N/A')
        print(f'    {tn}: CAR={r[\"CAR\"]:.2f}, TSR={r[\"TSR\"]:.2f}, avg_max_ee_disp={ee}')
    print()
"
